name: Creature & Adversary Scaling/Role Kit Contract
purpose: Provide reusable source-bounded adversary role and scaling kits that shape encounter expression without inventing unsupported creature mechanics or canon.
blocking_invariants: No unsupported powers, actions, reactions, resistances, immunities, weaknesses, phases, resources, tags, statistics, lore, relationships or canon may be invented.
Scaling is role/composition/presentation guidance first; numeric adjustment is permitted only when an owning source explicitly authorizes the exact parameter and range.
If source capability requirements are absent, the kit is not_applicable rather than repaired by invention.
Every kit identifies material GCL-07 pressure dimensions and preserves provenance/uncertainty.
No universal Challenge Rating, threat scalar, balance guarantee, or forced outcome.
Encounter composition, approval, comparison, simulation and Scene attachment remain MV-IA-F012/PPIA-11 authorities.
